user_goal: Top5% of actual competition entries; no leaderboard distribution is available so no percentile claim is supported
primary_selection: Official possession-spell F1, mean over four fixed external conditions
history: Adaptive development on two extensively reused Bundesliga matches.028/029 configured before rank-goal clarification. This030 policy is written before inspecting their outcome reports.
tradeoff: False-positive counts are reported, not a hard veto by themselves, because official spellF1 already scores matched/missed/spurious possession objects. This explicitly supersedes the earlier no-FP-increase deployment policy for rank-first selection.
eligibility: Mean spellF1>019; every prior condition/fold spellF1 loss<=.01; tracker-noise fold no decline; every per-state deadF1 decline<=.005. Tie within1e-6: higher macroF1, then fewer false positives.
freeze_policy: Select and hash one complete pipeline on old observation draws before any new-draw evaluation; no changes or alternative re-selection after that audit.
audit_policy: Evaluate019 and frozen selected candidate only. Diagnostic new missingness realisations on the same games, not a new-match test. If meanF1 does not improve, report failure and retain019 as predefined fallback; do not select a runner-up using audit results.
